content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TRAI Assistant Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TRAI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for the Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Assistant in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TRAI Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the TRAI Assistant position is 03 November 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before this date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Assistant post at TRAI?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed in Pay Level-06, with a salary range of Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400 per month, plus other admissible allowances as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is for a deputation position on foreign service terms. It is intended for existing government employees from Central/State departments or autonomous bodies.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant post at TRAI is 56 years as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the TRAI Assistant vacancy?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must apply through the official online portal at https://vacancies.trai.gov.in and also forward the hard copy of the application with required documents to the specified address in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on the evaluation of eligibility, Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) or Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APARs), and necessary vigilance/disciplinary and cadre clearances.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the TRAI Assistant recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be officers of Central/State Govt or autonomous bodies holding an analogous post or having regular service as UDC/LDC, along with proficiency in computer and office applications.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant post will be posted at the TRAI Regional Office located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
